findings: Original English raw-prefix November→December, K→L and XI→XII reproduced exactly.
Spanish raw qualifying cases retained their11th answers under all four masks, despite active gates in several cases.
Spanish no-thinking chat: Noviembre→Diciembre under final-input-only, input-only and all-position edits; XI→XII under input-only and all-position edits.
Spanish chat alphabet K→N under final-input-only, input-only and all-position edits; English chat alphabet K→N under input-only and all-position edits. These are11→14, not target11→12 successes.
Chinese one eligible raw month case and all three clean chat cases retained11th answers under all four masks despite active input gates.
English chat month stayed November; Roman XI→XII occurred only with all input+generated positions edited together.
All18 twelfth-query input-off controls retained their correct initial12th answer.
interpretation: Some cross-language and cross-domain causal transfer exists in Spanish, but it is strongly prompt/format-dependent and is not a reliable abstract add-one operation. Natural gate activation across languages does not guarantee the same effect of its input-dependent operator.
limits: Chat followup was added adaptively after raw-format failures; it is reported separately.
Conditions and domains are exploratory, not independent statistical samples or a language-general success rate.
Raw initial-answer scoring does not establish full-continuation coherence.
Only this model/checkpoint, feature and small prompt set were tested; no conclusion of Chinese impossibility.
No active unrelated norm-matched feature controls or exhaustive paraphrase search.
CPU vector reconstruction starts from saved standardized residuals; it is not a full independent model forward pass.
